title: FNAF Roleplay Game: Play Your Unofficial OC (Fan Options)
summary: Unofficial ways to roleplay your FNAF-inspired original character with clear fan-content labeling and consent tips.
body_markdown:

Five Nights at Freddy's and related names are trademarks of their owners. We discuss **original characters** inspired by the vibe of horror-animatronic stories—never official assets, and we make no trademark claims.


> **Quick answer:** To roleplay a FNAF-inspired original character, use spaces that allow fan OCs and clear unofficial labeling—friend Discord scenes, OC life-sims, or writing partners. This is not an official FNAF game list.

Table of Contents


Toggle


##


What "roleplay game" can mean here


#


- Text scenes with friends
- OC life-sims where characters move and talk
- Improvised night-shift stories you write turn by turn


##


How to keep it fun and clear


#


- State up front: unofficial fan OC
- Agree on tone (spooky-cozy vs pure horror)
- Consent on jumpscares and dark topics
- Keep official characters out unless your group explicitly wants AU cameos—and even then, be careful


##


Why a living world helps


#


Horror OCs get more interesting when they have downtime: break-room chats, petty rivalries, soft moments between scares. A pixel life-sim like Redbean lets **your** original characters exist between scenes—still fan creativity, never a licensed product.


##


Pair with the cluster


#


Bring a filled[template](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-oc-template) and one[idea](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/fnaf-oc-ideas) into play the same day you design them.


##


Scene starter pack


#


- Break room at 3:11
- Hallway camera blind spot
- Rain on the roof during a power flicker
- Someone rehearse a birthday song off-key


##


Group agreements worth writing down


#


- Rating / tone
- Whether injuries are fade-to-black
- How to pause a scene
- Whether crossovers with other fandoms are OK


Clear agreements keep unofficial play kind.


##


Keep notes outside the app


#


Whatever tool you try, keep a short external note with the character or pet name, the goal for this week, and three facts that must not drift. Apps change. Your notes travel.

##


Solo RP structure


#


Scene goal → obstacle → soft landing → note what changed for next time. Ten minutes is enough. Horror fatigue is real; stop while it is still fun.
